interfaces.owned_arrays: NumPy ndarray wrappers are replaced by owned array.array sequences/Tensor records; actual Hermes consumes the same PCM/WAV/chunk content without native imports.
interfaces.phonemizers: Actual eSpeak original data, models and phonemizer are qualified and embedded. Thai composes the independently qualified original TLTK th2ipa engine, its four consumed resources and unicode-rbnf number rules. Auxiliary Arabic/Hebrew ONNX resources remain original SHA-pinned packaged data with original optional override APIs. Main TTS voice models are not fetched automatically.
interfaces.settings: PiperConfig/SynthesisConfig/PhonemeType and DEFAULT_PHONEME_ID_MAP preserve original defaults and source semantics; speaker IDs, duration/noise scales and optional alignment outputs retain source argument/state contracts.
interfaces.synthesis: synthesize(text,syn_config=None,include_alignments=False) yields AudioChunk with standard-library float32/int16 arrays and original phonemes/IDs/alignment data. synthesize_wav serializes original little-endian PCM and WAV settings.
interfaces.voice: PiperVoice.load(model_path,config_path=None,use_cuda=False,espeak_data_dir=ESPEAK_DATA_DIR,download_dir=None,include_alignments=False). Original voice/config model data remain user supplied; all inference is qualified pure standard-library CPU code.

limitations: Runtime execution is CPU only; explicit use_cuda=True is rejected rather than silently claiming a GPU provider. Native GPU libraries and external execution are not used.

Original optional PINYIN/g2pW and JAPANESE/OpenJTalk backends are not yet ported; selecting them raises an explicit unavailable error. The Chinese-specific ID mapper is also explicitly refused rather than using the eSpeak mapping.
The original fixed voice data has four advertised eSpeak voice entries missing their required dictionary resource; actual dictionary consumption keeps an explicit failure.

Pure-Python VITS inference is much slower than native ONNX Runtime; trained short Hello reference runs take minutes on the qualified CPU. Main voice .onnx and .json data remain original user inputs, with original licensing, and are not embedded/fetched by this API.
No native library, ctypes, subprocess, dependency installation, remote TTS, silent algorithm fallback, fixed-phrase cache or quantized replacement is used.
scope: Actual original CPU PiperVoice API: original voice/config loading, typed phoneme configuration, raw phoneme blocks, real eSpeak/TEXT/Hebrew/Thai phonemization and Arabic neural diacritization, pure reviewed VITS ONNX inference, source noise/duration/speaker inputs, normalization/volume/PCM/WAV and optional phoneme alignment.

profile override, populated legacy cache, default voice and explicit voices_dir
